In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed.

questions.enonce_markdown: Given the matrices $A = \begin{pmatrix} 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -1 \end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix} -3 & 0 \\ 1 & 4 \end{pmatrix}$, state the transpose of the matrix $A$.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The transpose is obtained by writing the rows of $A$ as columns.

**Answer: $A^T = \begin{pmatrix} 5 & 3 \\ 2 & -1 \end{pmatrix}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Given the matrices $A = \begin{pmatrix} 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -1 \end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix} -3 & 0 \\ 1 & 4 \end{pmatrix}$, find the matrix $A - B$.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Subtract entry by entry:

$A - B = \begin{pmatrix} 5-(-3) & 2-0 \\ 3-1 & -1-4 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 8 & 2 \\ 2 & -5 \end{pmatrix}$.

**Answer: $A - B = \begin{pmatrix} 8 & 2 \\ 2 & -5 \end{pmatrix}$.**
